en.question: Who scored the "Hand of God" goal at the 1986 World Cup?
en.fact: It was against England in the quarter-final. Four minutes later he scored a solo goal that was later voted the Goal of the Century.

es.question: ¿Quién hizo el gol de la «Mano de Dios» en el Mundial de 1986?
es.fact: Fue contra Inglaterra en los cuartos de final. Cuatro minutos después hizo un gol individual que más tarde fue votado el Gol del Siglo.

en.question: What colour card does a referee show to send a player off?
en.fact: Cards were first used at the 1970 World Cup. English referee Ken Aston got the idea while waiting at a traffic light.

en.question: How long is a professional football match, not counting stoppage time?
en.fact: Two halves of 45 minutes. If a knockout game needs extra time, that adds two halves of 15.

en.question: Which country has won the most men's World Cups?
en.fact: Brazil has won five, and it's the only team to have played at every World Cup.

en.question: Which club has won the most European Cup and Champions League titles?
en.fact: Real Madrid won the first five European Cups in a row, from 1956 to 1960.

en.question: Which country won the first Women's World Cup, in 1991?
en.fact: It was held in China, and Michelle Akers scored both goals in the 2–1 final against Norway.

en.question: Who scored Uruguay's winning goal against Brazil in the 1950 "Maracanazo"?
en.fact: Schiaffino had equalised first. Ghiggia's goal made it 2–1 in front of around 200,000 people at the Maracanã.
